text:
oncall-bot: :rotating_light: Alert: spike in errors for streaming/paging endpoints after SDK v4.2 rollout. Error: frame_decode_failed, clients: mobile/sdk and node/sdk. Rolling error rate 5m: 18%.

olivia: seeing lots of "frame decode error" in logs, cursor payload length mismatch. Failures start ~10m after canary push.

sam: confirming. Canary was rolled to 20% about an hour ago. Can reproduce locally with v4.2 against edge-runtime.

maria: customers hitting 502s when resuming paged streams. CS flagged 3 paying customers reporting client-side disconnects.

devops-bot: Started rollback job: `kubectl -n edge-deploy rollout undo deployment/sdk-edge --to-revision=1` (job id roll-4150-1)

sam: executing emergency FF flip: `featureflagctl set enable_stream_v4 false --env=prod` — will cut the new handshake path.

maria: I toggled the flag in the UI, confirmed false. Pushing a note to support: `#support` and emailing account teams for affected customers.

joe: quick customer impact: OrgA (payment flows), OrgB (analytics ingest), OrgC (chat). OrgA reported 5 failed sessions in last 15m.

olivia: attaching minimal repro: client sends cursor header with base64 padding stripped -> runtime rejects. Likely a client-side encoding change in v4.2.

sam: opened PR with fallback decoder for legacy cursors — PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/1234

devops-bot: rollback completed to v4.1 canary; traffic reverted for canary cohort. Monitoring for error decay.

oncall-bot: Automated runbook step: add incident tag `paging-streaming` and assign severity S2.

sre-lead: great. Harper will take night oncall. Harper @harper please ack and note mitigation steps in PagerDuty runbook.

harper: ack. I'll monitor dashboards and ensure errors drop below 1%. Adding an alert for cursor-decode > 1% to the SRE dashboard.

sam: propose followups: force-compat hotfix in v4.2 to accept legacy cursor encoding, backfill tests for cursor encoding in CI, and stricter canary gates.

maria: support update sent to affected customers: short explanation + mitigation (rollback + workaround: pin SDK to v4.1). Waiting on CS confirmation for OrgA followups.

joe: created incident ticket INC-2026-0453 and linked to PR/rollback logs.

olivia: logs show error rate falling, 5m rolling -> 3.2% now. Good sign.

harper: handoff note for next oncall: watch errors, keep feature flag off until PR merged and deployed to canary, coordinate with release owner Sam for canary re-enable.

sam: thanks everyone. Will run compatibility patch and add extra unit tests. Will post updates in this thread when PR merged.

oncall-bot: :white_check_mark: Incident status: mitigated (flag off + rollback). Closing ephemeral alert, monitoring continues.
